items.title: File Widerspruch against Pflegegrad 2 decision
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Pflegekasse bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: The letter is dated Friday 28.03.2025 and gives no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post', so the posting day is 28.03.2025. The sender is a Pflegekasse, a social-law body under SGB XI/SGB X, so the delivery-fiction rule for 'other authorities/social-law bodies' applies (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): delivery is deemed to occur on the 4th day after posting, and this day is NOT moved even if it falls on a weekend or holiday. Counting from 28.03.2025: +4 calendar days = Tuesday 01.04.2025 (a normal working day anyway). The Widerspruch period is one month after Bekanntgabe (§ 84 SGG). Per the stated counting rule for months, the period ends on the day with the same number one month later than the event (delivery) day: 01.04.2025 + 1 month = 01.05.2025. However, 01.05.2025 (Tag der Arbeit) is a nationwide public holiday (also a Thursday), so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG the deadline moves to the next working day: Friday 02.05.2025.
